name: ccp_select_channel_endianness
description: CCP select_channel endianness and modulo test vectors. Validates: (1) EUI64 is concatenated as big-endian bytes, (2) epoch is concatenated as little-endian u32, (3) hash_32 is FNV-1a32 (basis=0x811c9dc5), and (4) CH0 is reserved so channel = 1 + (hash % (n_channels - 1)). Plans with no data channel fail closed to CH0. All implementations MUST match Python channel_plan.select_channel.

oracle.formula: data = eui64_bytes || epoch.to_le_bytes(4); h = fnv1a32(data); channel = 0 if n_channels <= 1 else 1 + (h % (n_channels - 1))

vectors.name: canonical_endianness_test
vectors.description: Canonical test for endianness: EUI64=0x0102030405060708, epoch=0x12345678 (305419896 decimal). EUI64 is big-endian (MSB first), epoch is little-endian u32.
vectors.notes: epoch 0x12345678 as LE bytes = 78 56 34 12. hash % 7 = 1, channel = 1 + 1 = 2.

vectors.name: epoch_1_standard
vectors.description: Standard vector with epoch=1. Verifies little-endian epoch encoding (0x01 0x00 0x00 0x00).

vectors.name: epoch_0_8_channels
vectors.description: Epoch=0 with 8 channels. Verifies zero epoch encoding (all zeros).

vectors.name: epoch_0_16_channels
vectors.description: Same data as epoch_0_8_channels but with 16 channels. Verifies n_channels affects result.

vectors.name: uppercase_eui64
vectors.description: EUI64 with uppercase hex letters. Verifies hex parsing handles case correctly.

vectors.name: single_data_channel
vectors.description: n_channels=2 contains CH0 and one data channel, so CH1 is selected deterministically.
vectors.notes: n_channels=2 leaves one data channel. Any hash modulo 1 selects CH1.

vectors.name: n_channels_exactly_3
vectors.description: n_channels=3 contains CH0 and two data channels. Output range is [1, 3).

vectors.name: max_epoch_u32
vectors.description: Maximum epoch value (2^32 - 1). Verifies full u32 range.
vectors.notes: epoch 0xFFFFFFFF as LE bytes = ff ff ff ff. 555378985 % 7 = 0, channel = 1.

vectors.name: all_zeros_eui64
vectors.description: All-zeros EUI64. Edge case for hash function.

vectors.name: all_ff_eui64
vectors.description: All-0xFF EUI64. Edge case for hash function.
